description: Pouch.me: build a Supplement Facts panel (21 CFR 101.36; products for adults and children 4 and over) from your user's own numbers: serving size, servings per container, the nutrients they declare (b2) and any other dietary ingredients or proprietary blends (b3), plus the bag's label area and the space for the panel if known. Returns the panel as an SVG preview (and a PDF print file on request), its minimum print size, the printed values, plain-English notes and the rule versions. Ask your user for the values; don't guess them. General information, not an FDA approval: the brand is responsible for its label.

amount.description: Amount per serving. For a blend, its total weight.
amount.title: Amount

blend.description: True for a proprietary blend; list its ingredients in items.
blend.title: Blend

constituents.description: Optional constituents with their amounts, printed indented under the ingredient (not for blends).
constituents.title: Constituents

items.description: A blend's ingredients, from most to least by weight (blends only).
items.title: Items

name.description: Name, e.g. 'Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera) root extract'. For botanicals, name the plant part.
name.title: Name

amounts.description: column (default: amounts in their own column) or inline (right after the names).
amounts.title: Amounts

area_sq_in.description: The bag's total label area in square inches, counting every printed side. It sets the smallest type allowed (under 12 sq in: 4.5 pt; 12 to 40 sq in: 6 pt, or 4.5 pt when crowded; over 40 sq in: 8 pt). Without it, standard 8 pt type is used.
area_sq_in.title: Area Sq In

columns.description: 1 (default) or 2 (the list continues in a second column, for wide, short spaces).
columns.title: Columns

space_mm.description: Optional [width, height] in mm of the space on the bag for the panel; the answer says whether it fits.
space_mm.title: Space Mm

type.description: auto (default: the smallest type the label area allows) or standard (8 pt).
type.title: Type

width_mm.description: Optional panel width in mm; automatic when left out.
width_mm.title: Width Mm

name.description: Product name, e.g. 'Daily Multivitamin'. Used in the file title and the print instructions; not printed on the panel.
name.title: Name

omit_servings.description: True to leave the servings line off, when the net quantity already says it (e.g. '60 Capsules' with a 1-capsule serving).
omit_servings.title: Omit Servings

per.description: The word after 'Amount Per' in the heading, e.g. 'Serving' (default), '2 Capsules' or 'Tablet'.
per.title: Per

servings.description: Servings per container. Required unless omit_servings is true. It is rounded as the rules require, with 'about' when rounded.
servings.title: Servings

size.description: Serving size in words, as it should print, e.g. '2 Capsules' or '1 Scoop (30 g)'.
size.title: Size

amino_acids_only.description: True if the product contains only individual amino acids: protein is then not declared.
amino_acids_only.title: Amino Acids Only

b2.description: Amounts per serving of the nutrients the product declares (21 CFR 101.36(b)(2)), as {nutrient_id: amount}. Calories as a number; fats, carbohydrate, fiber, sugars, sugar alcohol and protein in g; vitamin A, D and K, folate (mcg DFE), vitamin B12, biotin, iodine, selenium, chromium and molybdenum in mcg; cholesterol, sodium and every other vitamin and mineral in mg. Give the weight of the nutrient itself, e.g. calcium, not calcium carbonate. Amounts that round to zero, and vitamins and minerals under 2% of the Daily Value, are left off with a note.
b2.title: B2

b3.description: Other dietary ingredients without a Daily Value (21 CFR 101.36(b)(3)) and proprietary blends, in the order they should print.
b3.title: B3

folic_acid.description: Folic acid in mcg, if the folate comes from folic acid; printed under folate as '(xxx mcg folic acid)'. Folate in b2 must then be in mcg DFE.
folic_acid.title: Folic Acid

ingredients.description: The ingredient list printed under the panel: capsule, fillers, flavors, colors, and any source not named in the panel.
ingredients.title: Ingredients

ingredients_lead.description: How that list starts: auto (default: 'Other ingredients' when sources are named in the panel, else 'Ingredients'), 'Other ingredients' or 'Ingredients'.
ingredients_lead.title: Ingredients Lead

layout.description: Panel layout and the bag's size.

outputs.description: Files to return: svg (default: a preview at exact size) and/or pdf (the print file, as a data: link, about 40 to 55 KB).
outputs.title: Outputs

population.description: Who the product is for. Panels are made for adults_4plus (adults and children 4 and over) only; children_1_3, infants and pregnant are refused with the reason, because they use other Daily Values.
population.title: Population

protein_pdcaas.description: The protein's PDCAAS score (more than 0, at most 1). Needed to show protein's % Daily Value; without it that cell stays blank.
protein_pdcaas.title: Protein Pdcaas

serving.description: Serving size and servings per container.

sources.description: Optional source of a nutrient in b2, printed after its name, e.g. {"calcium": "as calcium carbonate"}.
sources.title: Sources

vitamin_d_iu.description: True to add vitamin D in IU after the mcg amount.
vitamin_d_iu.title: Vitamin D Iu

name: make_supplement_facts_panel
title: Make a Supplement Facts panel
